{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and internal test orders
df_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the number of completed orders after filtering
print("Number of completed orders after excluding test orders:", len(df_completed))

# Print the total revenue
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
